    Degree extraction from Gabriel push-down transformations #

    A natural transformation between two orbit push-down modules has a component in every deck degree. This file extracts the degree-a component by inserting the source module in degree zero, applying the transformation, and projecting to degree -a. Naturality for zero-degree orbit arrows turns the extracted component into an upstairs module map, and the inverse-precomposition translation isomorphism turns it into a genuine shifted morphism.
